reasons.reason: It explains that guest-list data are not automatically shared with the image provider.
reasons.evidence:

According to TableCards' design policies, **guest names/list data are not automatically shared with the image provider**. The AI background generation uses only the uploaded artwork (e.g., your business logo) as inspiration, not your guest data. 

For clarity, the system explicitly states:  
*"Guest names/list data are not automatically sent to the image provider."*  

Your privacy and data security are prioritized here. If you have further concerns, let me know!
